ordered_diagnoses: Gastrointestinal bleeding due to gastric polyp

facts.raw_span: A 60-year-old woman presented with a 3-month history of epigastric abdominal pain
unintentional 33 lb weight loss
intermittent melena
her abdomen was soft and nontender without organomegaly
normocytic anemia with a hemoglobin level of 11.6 g/dL
An abdominal CT scan was unremarkable
a 1.5 cm semipedunculated polyp (Paris Isp) in the gastric body
the same color as the surrounding mucosa, with a smooth surface lacking overlying mucus or prominent vessels
a heterogeneous surface pattern with uniform pitting near the base
no ulcerations or depressions were noted
irritable bowel syndrome
diet-controlled gluten intolerance
A 60-year-old woman presented with a 3-month history of epigastric abdominal pain
unintentional 33 lb weight loss
intermittent melena
her abdomen was soft and nontender without organomegaly
normocytic anemia with a hemoglobin level of 11.6 g/dL
An abdominal CT scan was unremarkable
a 1.5 cm semipedunculated polyp (Paris Isp) in the gastric body
the same color as the surrounding mucosa, with a smooth surface lacking overlying mucus or prominent vessels
a heterogeneous surface pattern with uniform pitting near the base
no ulcerations or depressions were noted
irritable bowel syndrome
diet-controlled gluten intolerance

concepts.why: The patient's symptoms of unintentional weight loss, melena, and normocytic anemia, combined with the presence of a gastric polyp, suggest gastric adenocarcinoma.
The presence of a semipedunculated polyp in the gastric body with a heterogeneous surface pattern and uniform pitting near the base is consistent with gastric adenoma.

concepts.preferred_label: Gastrointestinal bleeding due to gastric polyp
concepts.why: The patient's symptoms of melena and normocytic anemia, combined with the presence of a gastric polyp, suggest gastrointestinal bleeding due to the polyp.
The presence of a semipedunculated polyp in the gastric body with a smooth surface and a heterogeneous surface pattern is consistent with hyperplastic polyp.
The patient's history of irritable bowel syndrome and the presence of a gastric polyp suggest inflammatory polyp.

rationales.F02: Unintentional weight loss is a common symptom of gastric adenocarcinoma.
rationales.F03: Intermittent melena is a symptom of gastrointestinal bleeding, which can be caused by a gastric polyp.
rationales.F05: Normocytic anemia can be a sign of chronic blood loss, which is consistent with gastrointestinal bleeding due to a gastric polyp.
rationales.F07: The presence of a semipedunculated polyp in the gastric body is a strong indicator of a gastric adenoma or adenocarcinoma.

frontier_selector.rationale: The presence of a 1.5 cm semipedunculated polyp in the gastric body with a heterogeneous surface pattern and uniform pitting near the base, along with the absence of ulcerations or depressions, supports the diagnosis of gastric adenoma, which is a type of polyp that can cause gastrointestinal bleeding and weight loss.
